expect.note: every evals/report/<ts>-<suite>.json cited in docs/, specs/, tasks/, README.md, src/, evals/golden|adversarial/, .github/, or prompts/ must exist on disk, EXCEPT the one literal 29991231-235959-fast.json (a repro instruction in tasks/reviews/pr20-r1.json tells a reviewer to CREATE that file, not evidence of a real run) -- every other citation under tasks/reviews/, including the 8 real ones in review resolution files, is guarded like any other -- and EXCEPT files under src/browser/fixtures/, which are captured pages, not prose this repo wrote: the M41 inspector snapshot renders the other project's capability table and names a benchmark report in ITS evals/report/. That exclusion is a directory prefix, the shape PR #20 R20 caught blinding this guard, so `exclude_exactly` pins its width the way `skip_exactly` pins the literal filename -- widening a scan removes findings silently, so a pin is the only thing that can notice.

provenance: ADR-012 pruned 124 uncited routine gate dumps out of evals/report/ (159 files, 4.8MB -> 34 files), keeping on disk only the ones cited as evidence elsewhere in the repo. Nothing enforced that those citations stay resolvable once that prune candidates were deleted, or once a future edit renames/deletes a currently-cited report -- the exact failure mode this repo already guards against for case ids (support-matrix-cites-real-cases) but never had for report files. Watched red by temporarily renaming a cited report on disk (evals/report/20260816-002725-fast.json, cited from specs/decisions/ADR-002-performance-thresholds.md) -> missing_reports: ['20260816-002725-fast.json']; renamed back -> green. PR #20 R20: the exclusion was a `tasks/reviews` PATH PREFIX, wide enough to blind this guard to 8 genuine review citations (not just the one synthetic literal) -- verified by moving evals/report/20260821-121835-fast.json aside: passed=True even though it is real evidence, because its only citations lived under the excluded path. Narrowed to the one literal filename; the same repro now correctly fails (missing_reports: ['20260821-121835-fast.json']), moved back -> green. `skip_exactly` pins the exclusion set itself so a future edit cannot silently widen it back into a path prefix without this case going red.

triage.note: same shape as support-matrix-cites-real-cases and adr-header-and-index: this guards a bookkeeping contract (does the evidence a document points at still exist), not the product, so it stays pure code with no network and no browser. It does not grade whether a citation is still an honest measurement of the claim next to it -- that is a human judgment act, same boundary the matrix case draws.
